description: Fixed source-only evaluation of five posterior temperatures, with and without learned weight correction, on previously explored RX8 records.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。
